title: Why he started on drums, and early heroes Bucket and Ransom
summary: Breaux says he took up drums just to get into the band, and recalls sneaking in to watch Bucket play drums and liking Ransom's bass.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Say, I was wondering, uh, the other questions, they're going to have about a half a minute left.
Did you admire any drummers that caused you to start on drums, particular?

No, I don't know how I got tangled up with the drum. At that time, I don't think I was any more than about 11 or 12 years old. And, uh, I just wanted to get in the band. I didn't care what I played. You know, I imagine that's the way I must have felt. You didn't hang around the big 25 or
